title: Cripple Creek
description: A federal agent (George Montgomery) and two colleagues infiltrate a gang of gold-rush gold smugglers.

title: Gunmen From Laredo
description: A framed Texas rancher escapes from prison for a showdown with a saloon keeper.

title: Wyoming Renegades
description: An ex-convict (Phil Carey) and his girlfriend (Martha Hyer) cannot start over until they stop Butch Cassidy's (Gene Evans) gang.

title: The Guns of Fort Petticoat
description: An Army deserter (Audie Murphy) shows defenseless Texas women how to hold off Indians out to avenge a massacre.

title: The Violent Men
description: A rancher (Glenn Ford) fights a land-grabbing cattle baron (Edward G. Robinson) whose wife (Barbara Stanwyck) and brother are having an affair.

title: The Hard Man
description: A Texas Ranger (Guy Madison) turns deputy sheriff; a woman (Valerie French) wants him to kill her cattle-baron husband (Lorne Greene).

title: Seminole Uprising
description: An Army lieutenant (George Montgomery) is ordered to go after Florida Indians in Texas.

title: The Mountain Men
description: Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.

title: Al Jennings of Oklahoma
description: Lawyer Al (Dan Duryea) and brother Frank (Dick Foran) turn to robbing banks and trains after Union troops raid their home.

title: The Nebraskan
description: War looms on the horizon when an Army officer's American Indian aide is accused of murdering a tribal elder.

title: Edge of Eternity
description: An Arizona lawman (Cornel Wilde) traps a killer gold thief (Mickey Shaughnessy) and his hostage (Victoria Shaw) in a yellow tram spanning the Grand Canyon.

title: The Nevadan
description: An undercover U.S. marshal (Randolph Scott) and a crooked rancher follow an outlaw (Forrest Tucker) to stolen gold.

title: Hangman's Knot
description: A Confederate (Randolph Scott) and his men rob Union gold in Nevada, then learn the war's been over for a month.

title: Jubal
description: A Wyoming rancher's (Ernest Borgnine) wife eyes a drifter (Glenn Ford), and her ex-lover (Rod Steiger) tells her husband.

title: The Texas Rangers
description: The fastest gun (George Montgomery) in Texas is let out of prison to help the Rangers stop a gang of outlaws.

title: The Blazing Trail
description: A worthless gold mine leads the Durango Kid and a newspaperman on a trail marked by suspicion and deceit.

title: Masterson of Kansas
description: Bat Masterson (George Montgomery), Doc Holliday (James Griffith) and Wyatt Earp rescue a framed rancher and stop an Indian war.

title: Battle of Rogue River
description: A cavalry major (George Montgomery) makes peace with Indians despite an agitator (Richard Denning) working for carpetbaggers.

title: The Last Frontier
description: Three trappers become scouts for a cavalry captain (Guy Madison) who loses his fort to a hated colonel (Robert Preston).

title: Go West, Young Girl!
description: New England writer Netty and cavalry widow Gilda team up to find Billy the Kid.

title: The Pathfinder
description: A British scout (Kevin Dillon) infiltrates a French stronghold near the Great Lakes during the 1750s.

title: Face of a Fugitive
description: A bank robber (Fred MacMurray) takes a new name in another town and falls for the lawyer-sheriff's (Lin McCarthy) sister (Dorothy Green).

title: The Longest Drive
description: Two brothers (Kurt Russell, Tim Matheson), one raised by Indians, seek their sister in the 1890s West.

title: Gun Fury
description: A peaceful man (Rock Hudson) hunts down the outlaw (Phil Carey) who has abducted his bride (Donna Reed).

title: Headin' East
description: A cowboy discards his chaps and saddle for a suit and tie when he travels to the big city to investigate a produce racket that has been ruining his father's lettuce shipments.

title: The Thrill Hunter
description: After lying about being a stuntman, a blowhard (Buck Jones) gets the chance to prove himself to a movie studio.

title: The Return of Daniel Boone
description: The scout's grandson (Bill Elliott) foils land-grabbers; his sidekick (Dub Taylor) flirts with twins.

title: Massacre Canyon
description: A cavalry officer and two of his men set out to make sure that a shipment of guns safely reaches its destination.

title: Mackenna's Gold
description: Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.
